bio.text: Nick Schultz was first elected to the Assembly in 2024 and represents California's 44th Assembly District, which includes Burbank and Glendale; he chairs the Assembly Public Safety Committee.
He was previously a Deputy Attorney General with the California Department of Justice, was elected to the Burbank City Council in 2020 and became Mayor of Burbank in 2023.
Schultz has a bachelor's degree and a law degree from the University of Oregon and lives in Burbank.
